lines.text: Forty-five centuries ago, ancient Egyptians aligned two million stone blocks to true north with near-zero errorâ€”without pulleys, iron, or wheels.
Over twenty thousand skilled workers cut massive limestone blocks with copper chisels and dragged them across wet desert sands.
The recently discovered Diary of Merer reveals elite crews ferried white casing stones along artificial canals straight from the Nile.
Inside the monument, builders constructed the soaring Grand Gallery, balancing colossal granite beams weighing sixty tons each.
Each side faces cardinal directions with accuracy surpassing modern architecture, built as an eternal cosmic stairway for Pharaoh Khufu.
The sole surviving Ancient Wonder of the World still defies explanation. Subscribe to Beyond History for more.
